# Flowgraph blocks

Every block of the `flowgraph` device (python/flowgraph_bridge.py, python/audio_blocks.py): what it does, its parameters (generated from the live block catalog), inputs and outputs, a runnable example with a screenshot, and the prompt / MCP calls that build it. A graph is `{blocks: [{id, type, params}], links: [[from, to]]}`; each block has at most one input and an output can feed several blocks. Results land in the lab as traces, channels, values, blobs and audio streams named `fg_<block id>` (for a device called `fg`).

Regenerate after changing a block or its docs: `yarn block-docs` (README files) and `yarn block-shots [block...]` (screenshots).

## Sources

Where samples come from: test signals, files, SDRs, lab audio.

- [`signal`](signal/README.md): complex tone plus noise, the basic test signal
- [`modulated`](modulated/README.md): ready-made RRC-shaped digital test signal (PSK/QAM/APSK) with noise and offsets
- [`file`](file/README.md): plays a raw cf32 IQ recording in real time
- [`audio_file`](audio_file/README.md): plays an audio file (WAV/FLAC/MP3/..., via ffmpeg) as real samples
- [`soapy`](soapy/README.md): live IQ from a SoapySDR receiver (RTL-SDR, HackRF, bladeRF...)
- [`audio_in`](audio_in/README.md): a lab audio stream (browser mic, another graph) into the graph

## Channel and impairments

Make a clean test signal realistic: noise, carrier offset, phase, gain.

- [`channel`](channel/README.md): AWGN, carrier offset, phase and gain between TX and RX

## Filters and DSP

Frequency shifting, resampling, filtering, gain control, gating.

- [`shift`](shift/README.md): moves a signal at +offset Hz to 0 Hz
- [`resample`](resample/README.md): any-ratio, anti-aliased resampler to a new rate
- [`lowpass`](lowpass/README.md): Kaiser FIR low-pass / channel filter
- [`agc`](agc/README.md): normalizes IQ to unit power
- [`mag`](mag/README.md): magnitude |x|: envelope detector
- [`decimate`](decimate/README.md): keeps every n-th sample (no filtering)
- [`matched_filter`](matched_filter/README.md): RRC receive filter matching the transmitter
- [`level_trigger`](level_trigger/README.md): power squelch: catches bursts above a level (blob, trace, log)

## Modulation, demodulation and sync

Bits and audio to IQ and back: modulators, demodulators, timing and carrier recovery, slicing.

- [`fm_demod`](fm_demod/README.md): FM demodulator to audio
- [`am_demod`](am_demod/README.md): AM / USB / LSB demodulator to audio
- [`symbol_sync`](symbol_sync/README.md): symbol timing recovery, one sample per symbol out
- [`carrier_recovery`](carrier_recovery/README.md): decision-directed PLL removing carrier offset and phase
- [`demod`](demod/README.md): symbol decisions and EVM for a linear scheme
- [`mod`](mod/README.md): bits to IQ: PSK, QAM, APSK, OOK, FSK, MSK, GFSK, GMSK...
- [`analog_mod`](analog_mod/README.md): audio to AM, DSB, SSB, FM or PM baseband
- [`discriminator`](discriminator/README.md): FSK / FM discriminator, symbols as ±1
- [`clock_recovery`](clock_recovery/README.md): Gardner timing recovery for FSK / OOK / real symbols
- [`slicer`](slicer/README.md): symbols to bits (linear schemes or 2/4-level real), with EVM

## Digital: bits, framing, BER, UART, protocol decode

Bit sources and everything that consumes bits or logic samples.

- [`bits`](bits/README.md): PRBS or pattern bit source, optionally framed
- [`ber`](ber/README.md): bit error rate against a PRBS, self-synchronizing
- [`framer`](framer/README.md): finds a sync word and cuts frames from bits
- [`bitview`](bitview/README.md): shows the last bits of a stream as binary and hex
- [`uart_tx`](uart_tx/README.md): UART transmitter: text or hex to line levels
- [`uart_rx`](uart_rx/README.md): UART receiver: line levels or bits to text
- [`decode`](decode/README.md): sigrok / builtin protocol decoder on logic samples (UART, SPI, I2C...)

## Audio processing

Realtime audio: filters, notches, dynamics, noise reduction. Parameters change live through set_param.

- [`biquad`](biquad/README.md): RBJ biquad: low/high/band-pass, notch, peaking, shelves
- [`fir_filter`](fir_filter/README.md): linear-phase FIR low/high/band-pass, band-stop
- [`hum_notch`](hum_notch/README.md): 50/60 Hz mains hum and harmonics remover
- [`auto_notch`](auto_notch/README.md): finds and notches stationary tones automatically
- [`dc_block`](dc_block/README.md): removes DC offset
- [`compressor`](compressor/README.md): dynamics compressor with knee, lookahead, sidechain HPF
- [`limiter`](limiter/README.md): brickwall lookahead limiter
- [`gate`](gate/README.md): noise gate / downward expander
- [`audio_agc`](audio_agc/README.md): audio level AGC to a target dBFS
- [`spectral_nr`](spectral_nr/README.md): spectral noise reduction (Wiener / subtraction)
- [`declick`](declick/README.md): removes clicks and crackle
- [`denoise`](denoise/README.md): neural speech denoise (DeepFilterNet, RNNoise)

## Sinks and views

What makes a stream visible or audible: spectrum, scope, constellation, eye, measurements, audio, WAV.

- [`spectrum`](spectrum/README.md): spectrum analyzer trace: RBW, window, max/min hold, averaging
- [`constellation`](constellation/README.md): I/Q scatter of symbols
- [`eye`](eye/README.md): eye diagram
- [`scope`](scope/README.md): triggered oscilloscope with measurements
- [`measure`](measure/README.md): one statistic of the stream as a channel
- [`audio`](audio/README.md): plays audio in the browser (lab audio stream)
- [`wav`](wav/README.md): records audio to a WAV file

## Network

Raw IQ or logic samples in and out over TCP/UDP.

- [`net_source`](net_source/README.md): IQ or logic samples in over TCP / UDP
- [`net_sink`](net_sink/README.md): IQ or logic samples out over TCP / UDP

## Scripting

Your own DSP in a block.

- [`python`](python/README.md): your own work(x, rate) in python
